pages.title_tag: Toyota Supra Import Eligibility Australia | Import Check
pages.intro_copy: Two Supras, thirty years apart, and the register covers both. The JZA80 is the one with the 2JZ, and most of them are now old enough for the 25-year pathway, which does not use this register at all. The current A90 is the opposite: far too young for the age route, and Australia sold it new, so an import depends on a live approval for the specific build window. If you are shopping the A80, check your car's build month against the age cutoff first, because that route is usually the cheaper one when it applies.
pages.meta_description: Can a Toyota Supra be imported to Australia? Live SEVS and MRE approvals by chassis code and build date, read from the ROVER register and rechecked daily.
